title: Fixed Tail-Vane Farm Windpump
description: One newly authored whole static farm windpump appearance: a four-foot tapered open square braced tower supports a small fixed gearbox, a broad wheel of pitched sheet-like fan vanes on two genuine annular rings and four short inner spokes, a rear projecting tail vane, and a long central connection rod down to a grounded pump-body exterior with one genuinely open finite bent outlet. This is a complete new windpump silhouette and construction, not the old three-blade electric turbine with merely more blades or a copied communications tower. No prior visible mesh is imported or extracted. Closed editable meshes and four opaque constant matte PBR roles. Small embedded junctions fix the display. Metres, Z up, true whole horizontal bounds centre and actual finite ground feet. Static game-art only: no rotation/animation, yaw bearing, gears, crank linkage, fluid path through the housing, wind or water simulation, pumping output, electrical generation, installation, structural stability or engineering/safety certification.
